intro: Professionals and everyday users convert weeks (wk) to days (d) when working across other and other standards in project scheduling, payroll timecards, scientific interval logging, and server uptime SLAs. One week equals 7 days, while 1 day equals 0.142857 weeks. Whether you are verifying time specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many days (d) are in 1 week (wk)?
faqs.answer: There are 7 days (d) in 1 week (wk), which rounds to 7 d for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 day equals 0.142857 weeks.

faqs.question: How do I convert weeks to days (wk to d)?
faqs.answer: To convert weeks to days, use the formula: d = wk × 7. For example, converting 10 wk gives 70 d.

faqs.question: What is 10 weeks in days?
faqs.answer: 10 weeks (wk) equals exactly 70 days (d) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
